offering_description.value: Owns and operates self storage facilities that rent storage units to individuals and businesses. Properties are in the US and Canada. Also manages facilities for third parties and sponsors investment programs.

primary_services.value: self storage unit rental; third-party property management; tenant insurance and protection plans; investment program sponsorship

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals and households renting storage units; B2B: small businesses renting storage space, third-party facility owners using management services

end_markets.value: self storage; residential moving and downsizing; small business storage; real estate

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: monthly rents for storage units; commissions or management fees: fees for managing third-party and sponsored facilities; service fees: tenant insurance, protection plan and ancillary fees
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs self storage facilities rented to individuals and businesses; service provider: manages third-party and sponsored storage properties for owners and investors

geography_served.value: North America: US states such as Florida, Texas, California, Georgia, plus Toronto, Canada

specialization.value: niche specialist: self storage ownership and operation, with related management and sponsorship activities

distribution_channels.value: own locations: on-site rental offices at storage facilities; online: website reservations and online rentals; direct sales: call center and in-person leasing

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules, SEC securities regulation, zoning, lien-sale and consumer rules, insurance rules for tenant protection
